numinance.kinds.v1.LockedExtension.jsons.description: LockedExtension pins one extension version by what was verified at install, never by what its manifest declares.

digest.description: digest is the content digest the installer recomputed over the package content with manifest.yaml excluded.

h1.description:
h1 is the hash of the unpacked tree: "h1:" plus the standard base64 of a sha256 over the sorted per-file
 sha256 lines (the Go module tree hash), 47 characters.

id.description: id is the plugin_id of the manifest: a reverse-DNS identifier of at least two labels.

permissions_digest.description:
permissions_digest is the digest of the accepted permission set (the canonical form of the manifest's kind, ports and
 capabilities with their intents); a change of it is recomputed from the manifest and shown as a permission diff.

signer.description:
signer is the signer identity verified at install, the OIDC issuer plus subject pair as the manifest declares it;
 a different signer for a locked id is a widening that needs approval.

version.description: version is the strict x.y.z version installed.

zh.description: zh is the hash of the archive as downloaded: "zh:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters of its sha256.

numinance.kinds.v1.LockedExtension.jsons.title: Locked Extension

numinance.kinds.v1.LockedKnowledgeTool.j.description:
LockedKnowledgeTool pins one tool of a knowledge connection by the hash of its canonicalised description, schemas and
 annotations (design section 14). Drift quarantines the connection.

connection.description: connection is the name of the KnowledgeConnection.

name.description: name is the tool name as the server lists it.

numinance.kinds.v1.LockedKnowledgeTool.j.title: Locked Knowledge Tool

numinance.kinds.v1.Lockfile.jsonschema.s.description:
Lockfile is the document .numinance.lock.yaml at the repository root: it pins every installed extension and every
 approved knowledge tool inventory (design section 8 row Lockfile, section 17 "Governed install"). The install flow
 writes it; a person reviews it in a pull request and never types a hash. It holds no credential and no extension
 content. Install and load fail closed on any mismatch between a pin and what is installed.

extensions.description: extensions holds vendor or customer data under reverse-DNS keys; the Engine never reads it.

metadata.description: metadata is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

spec.description: spec is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.Lockfile.jsonschema.s.title: Lockfile

numinance.kinds.v1.LockfileSpec.jsonsche.description:
LockfileSpec is the pinned set. Both lists may be empty (a repository that installed nothing); entries are unique by
 their key, and the install flow writes them sorted by it so a diff shows one change.

extensions.description: extensions are the installed extensions, unique by id: one version of one extension per lockfile.

knowledge_tools.description: knowledge_tools are the admin-approved tool inventories of knowledge connections, unique by connection and name.

numinance.kinds.v1.LockfileSpec.jsonsche.title: Lockfile Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.description: Metadata names a kind object and fixes its scope.

name.description: name is required and unique per kind and scope; other kinds reference the object by it.

scope.description: scope is required and not SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED; the loader enforces the latter.
scope.title: Scope

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.title: Metadata

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.description: Digest is a sha256 content digest as "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters.

value.description:
value is exactly "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters. Any other
 length, case or prefix, and an empty value in a present message, is
 rejected. Absence is the unset message.

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.title: Digest
